note: Rewritten from the species-level description by Bourguignon & Roisin (2011), the original in English; the soldier and the alate are described. The measurements keep the mm unit of the original; abbreviations are given in parentheses at their first occurrence.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is small with the apex of the mandibles extremely curved; it is most similar to the Australian Coptotermes lacteus and the Malay Peninsula species C. bentongensis and C. sepangensis, but can be distinguished from the other species of New Guinea by its small size and the curved mandibular apex.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head densely hairy; pronotum with many medium-sized and large setae; antennae 17-segmented. Measurements (mm, 6 individuals of the same colony): total body length (TBL) 5.75—6.39; head length to clypeus (HLC) 1.09—1.18; head width including eyes (HWE) 1.30—1.38; pronotum length (PL) 0.57—0.73; pronotum width (PW) 0.97—1.08; forewing length (FWL) 9.92—11.09; eye diameter (ED) 0.33—0.44.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Small. Head slightly longer than wide, with about 20 setae; fontanelle aperture facing forwards, not visible from above; antennae usually 14-segmented, occasionally 13-segmented; pronotum wider in front than behind, trapezoidal, with about 50 setae; mandibular apex extremely curved, the right mandible with 4 serrations. Measurements (mm, 5 individuals of the type colony; in parentheses 72 individuals from 24 colonies): head length to fontanelle (HLF) 1.11—1.19 (1.01—1.29); head length including mandibles (HLL) 1.45—1.56 (1.23—1.63); head width (HW) 1.00—1.04 (0.83—1.11); pronotum length (PL) 0.36—0.39 (0.29—0.46); pronotum width (PW) 0.67—0.70 (0.59—0.78); right mandible length (RML) 0.78—0.83 (0.69—0.85); postmentum width (MPW) 0.28—0.31 (0.26—0.38); hind tibia length (T3L) 0.83—0.89 (0.68—0.99).

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Kavieng, New Ireland; widely distributed in the forests of New Guinea, abundant in the Bird's Neck region of Papua, Indonesia.
